checklist.notes: All five tasks practise present-simple forms used in short personal-information statements; the ordering task also contextualizes personal information.
Closed tasks provide immediate models and explanations, and correction makes the agreement rule observable.
The set moves across recognition, controlled production, matching, ordering, and correction, although challenge remains narrowly controlled.
Instructions are brief, concrete, and paired with bounded response formats.
One form distinction is held constant, keeping memory and language demands suitable for A1.1.
Vietnamese names and places provide familiar context, while repeated third-person -s practice addresses a useful form contrast for Vietnamese learners without stereotyping.
Five short objective tasks are feasible in a compact practice block.

methods: Reviewed the exercise set and audit against the declared original project-authored policy and external-payload/media declarations.
copyright_originality_check.scope_limitations: No Internet-wide copyright or plagiarism search was performed; this review checked only the declared original project-authored policy and supplied artifact evidence.

findings.description: Four of five items concentrate on third-person singular agreement, so the set offers limited growth beyond the same form distinction.
findings.recommendation: In a future revision, vary one item to practise a different present-simple subject pattern while retaining the personal-information objective.

limitations: This is an independent AI pedagogical review for development evidence, not human review or release approval.
The review covers the supplied immutable exercise set and automated audit; it does not report an Internet-wide originality search.
